title: PBA: Rain or Shine books quarters duel with Converge after 30-point beating of Phoenix
summary: Rain or Shine will enter the PBA Season 50 Governors' Cup quarterfinals armed with a win after dealing Phoenix a 30-point beating, 133-103, to cap its Group B campaign on Friday at the Ynares Center…
